rules.description: Focus on Dockerfile and docker-compose files
rules.instruction: Maintain Dockerfiles in backend/ and frontend/. Update docker-compose files at root level.
Use separate build and runtime stages. Copy only necessary artifacts. Minimize final image size.

rules.description: Keep dev and prod configurations separate
rules.instruction: Use docker-compose.yml for dev, docker-compose.prod.yml for production. Never mix configurations.
Configure nginx in nginx/ directory. Set up proper proxy headers. Enable compression and caching.
Add HEALTHCHECK instructions to Dockerfiles. Configure health checks in compose files.

rules.description: Follow security best practices for containers
rules.instruction: Use non-root users. Scan for vulnerabilities. Use specific image versions. Minimize attack surface.
Use alpine or slim base images. Multi-stage builds. Clean up in same layer. Order instructions by change frequency.
Keep docker-compose.yml, docker-compose.prod.yml, docker-compose.nas.yml synchronized for common services.
